info.name: Sprint1
info.description:
Security Incident Detection and Response Management System - Sprint I API collection, EECE 435L.

Team: Hassane El Khatib, Yehia Afesh, Abdul Rahman Habbal.

| Folder | Service | Port | Developed by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Users | Users and Identity Management | 5001 | Hassane El Khatib |
| Assets | Asset Management | 5002 | Yehia Afesh |
| Incidents | Incident Management | 5003 | Yehia Afesh |
| Threats | Threat Intelligence | 5004 | Abdul Rahman Habbal |
| Logs | Security Audit Logging | 5005 | Hassane El Khatib |
| Reports | Security Reports | 5006 | Abdul Rahman Habbal |
| Vulnerabilities | Vulnerability Management | 5007 | Yehia Afesh |
| Notifications | Notification and Alert Management | 5008 | Hassane El Khatib |
| Playbooks | Security Playbook and Response | 5009 | Abdul Rahman Habbal |

Usage: select the "Sprint1_Local" environment, start the services (python main.py), run "00 Auth helpers" first, then run each folder's requests in order. Every request name starts with the full name of the student who developed that API, and every request checks its expected status code.

item.name: 00 Auth helpers
item.description: Shared by the whole team. Run this folder first (Run folder). Each request logs in one test account through the User Login API and stores its JWT in the environment (admin_token, analyst_token, employee_token, auditor_token, ...), which every other folder uses. Tokens expire after 60 minutes.

item.name: Login helper - admin (Security Administrator)

request.description:
**User Login** (POST /users/login, public)

Authenticates a user with username (or email) and password. Passwords are verified against bcrypt hashes. Inactive and suspended accounts are refused.

Body: `username`, `password`

Success: 200 with a JWT `token` (valid 60 minutes).

Errors: 400 missing fields, 401 invalid username or password, 403 account Inactive/Suspended.

item.name: 01 Users
item.description:
Users and Identity Management Service (port 5001): registration, login, profile updates, deletion and lookups with role-based access control.

Developed by: Hassane El Khatib

item.name: Hassane El Khatib - User Registration - regular user success [A-01]

request.description:
**User Registration** (POST /users/register)

Creates an account. Anyone may register a Regular User; only a Security Administrator (Bearer token) may create other roles.

Body: `full_name`, `username`, `email`, `password`, `department`, `role` (all required).

Validation: required fields, email format, username 3-30 letters/digits/underscores and unique, email unique, password at least 8 characters with upper, lower, digit and special character, role one of the 4 roles.

Success: 201 with the created user (no password).

Errors: 400 validation, 403 non-admin creating a privileged role, 409 duplicate username or email.

request.description:
**Update User Information** (PUT /users/{id})

Roles: Security Administrator (any user; may also change `role` and `account_status`), Regular User (own account only: `full_name`, `email`, `department`).

Success: 200 with the updated user. Role and status changes are logged (ROLE_CHANGED, ACCOUNT_STATUS_CHANGED) and the user is notified.

Errors: 400 invalid or non-updatable field, 401 no token, 403 wrong role or another user's account, 404 user not found, 409 email taken.

item.name: 05 Logs
item.description:
Security Audit Logging Service (port 5005): immutable audit records created automatically by every service, with retrieval, search, per-user history and admin-only deletion.

Developed by: Hassane El Khatib

item.name: Hassane El Khatib - Create Log Record - admin creates log [A-26]

request.description:
**Create Log Record** (POST /logs)

Roles: Security Administrator, or other services using the internal X-Service-Key header.

Body: `user_id`, `action`, `description`, `severity` (Information, Warning, Error, Critical), `related_service` (one of the 9 services). The timestamp is set by the database.

Success: 201 with the log.

Errors: 400 validation or unknown user, 401 no token, 403 role not allowed.
